what_it_changes: Non-binding first reading of the validator support programme
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "It is non-binding and carries no direct outcomes."

what_it_changes: Non-binding first reading of the rewards programme for veNEAR holders
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "It is non-binding and carries no direct outcomes."

what_it_changes: Three months of rewards to veNEAR holders
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "an initial 3-month rewards program for veNEAR holders" with "a budget of 280,682 NEAR". No payment is traced in the warehouse.

what_it_changes: 150 NEAR a quarter to each of the 100 smallest validators with 97% uptime, for the fourth quarter of 2025 only
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "150 NEAR per quarter to the 100 smallest validators who maintain 97% uptime" and "This proposal covers only Q4 2025". The 15,000 NEAR is 150 times 100. No payment is traced in the warehouse.

what_it_changes: Non-binding first reading of House of Stake's mission, vision and values
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "It is non-binding and carries no direct outcomes."

what_it_changes: Monthly pay, from protocol emissions, to up to 21 Chain Signatures node operators at a fixed NEAR rate per node
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "performance-based monthly compensation to up to 21 MPC node operators", "NEAR-anchored at a fixed rate per node, with payments executed on-chain from House of Stake wallets". The text on the contract gives no amount. No payment is traced in the warehouse.

what_it_changes: Ratifies six constitutional documents of House of Stake: the constitution, voting procedures, the screening committee's charter, mission and values, the conflict of interest policy and the code of conduct
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "This single vote ratifies a bundle of the six NEAR House of Stake Constitutional Document HSPs", HSP-008 to HSP-013.

what_it_changes: House of Stake's operating budget for July 2026 to June 2027: 60,000 NEAR and 196,000 USD
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "196,000 USD + 60,000 NEAR" and "the first proposal to fund House of Stake operations from its own treasury". Its frontmatter reads "hsp: TBD", so it has no number here. No payment is traced in the warehouse.

what_it_changes: The contracts' share of gas fees from 30% to zero, so the whole fee is burned
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "Eliminate the 30% developer gas rebate and direct all execution fee burn to the protocol" and "burnt_gas_reward = 0". Its frontmatter reads "hsp: TBD". In force: registry/protocol_upgrades.csv, protocol version 87, whose first block set the contracts' share from 30% to 0.

what_it_changes: The root of NEAR's top-level account names is governed by House of Stake, with its Security Council as registrar
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "places governance of the top-level namespace within NEAR House of Stake" and "appoints the House of Stake Security Council as Registrar". Its text gives no HSP number.

what_it_changes: The cap on issuance from 2.5% to 1.6% a year, in a straight line over 24 months
evidence: Its text on vote.dao: "cap(t) = 2.5% − 0.9% × min(t, 24)/24", "Activation occurs one full quarter after ratification", "A grace period of 90 days follows before the first basis point comes off", and "This proposal cannot take effect on a House of Stake vote alone": changing the cap "requires validator adoption through the standard upgrade process". The number HSP-029 is from its forum thread's title. in_force_date stays empty until fct_protocol_config.max_inflation_rate reads below 0.025.
